mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances following a 3-month GDP increase, or GDP growth does not correlate significantly with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE spikes and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production index by more than 1% in a single month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to lower corporate output and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP and housing starts by more than 1% each in a single month signals a robust demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in GDPC1 and HOUST does not correlate significantly with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a single month signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and increases corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP and retail sales by more than 1% each in a single month signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in GDPC1 and RSAFS does not correlate significantly with positive returns (p > 0.05).
